notes.title: Just Pizza Patch Notes - Version 1.1 Linux
notes.content:
Hello Pizza Lovers!

We are thrilled to announce the release of the Linux version of Just Pizza! Now, even more players can join in on the fun and enjoy the ultimate pizza-clicking experience on their preferred platform.

What’s New:

Linux Version Release: Just Pizza is now available on Linux! We can’t wait to see our Linux community dive into the game and start clicking pizzas.

Fixes and Improvements:


 Stackable Items Fix: We’ve addressed an issue where stackable items in the in-game inventory were only showing once. Now, these items will correctly split a few seconds after you enter the game
 Leveling System Adjustments: We’ve fixed several problems that a few users experienced with the leveling system. Your progression should now be more consistent and enjoyable.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update v1.1
notes.content:
New Features and Improvements

New Button Icons

We’ve revamped the look of our buttons with brand-new icons! Enjoy a more intuitive and visually appealing interface.

Workshop Support

We’re excited to introduce Workshop support! You can now:
Upload your custom items.
Vote on your favorite creations.
Share your designs with the community.
Earn money from accepted items. Get creative and start contributing!

Gameplay Adjustments

First Time Drop Adjustment

The first item drop time has been reduced from 1 minute to 10 seconds.

notes.title: Just Pizza Contest: Invite and Win Prizes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have great news for you! We’re organizing a super fun contest on our Discord, and everyone has a chance to win amazing prizes! 😍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089885/bd6fed74d0967c2bd2de406995b00af0ac1f8a6c.gif

🔔 Eligibility Requirements:


 Invite friends to our Discord server.
 Invitations must be accepted and valid at the time of verification.
 If an invited user leaves the server, the invitation will not be counted.


🏆 Prizes Offered:


 Rare Item: Invite 3-5 people.
 Legendary Item: Invite 6-10 people.
 Unique Item: Invite 11 or more people.


📋 Important Details:


 Invitations must be created using Server Name  -> Invite People. 
 Quick invites (right-click on user and invite) will not work.
 To check how many people you’ve invited, use the /invites @user command in the ⁠╠✅╣check_invites   channel.
 Prizes will be awarded at the end of the contest.

notes.title: Exciting Announcement for Our Just Pizza Community!
notes.content:
Hey Pizza Enthusiasts,


We are beyond excited to announce that 🍕Just Pizza is now officially released to the public! After an amazing journey through closed beta, filled with your invaluable feedback and support, we are ready to share the full experience with everyone. This release brings a host of new features, enhancements, and a sneak peek into our future plans.

🌟 Highlights of This Update:


 Public Release: Just Pizza is now available for everyone! Tell your friends, family, and fellow pizza lovers to join the fun.
 New Features: Explore new items in the shop, experience a revamped UI with fresh sound effects, and benefit from our new leveling system.
 Upcoming Enhancements: Discover our plans for a new Workshop, more events, and an in-game store.
 Bug Fixes & Known Issues: We've tackled several issues and are actively working on others to ensure a smoother gaming experience.


⚙️ Patch Notes Release:

New Features:


 The Beta Tester Coin will no longer drop.
 For 24 hours, Pizza Legacy drops will be available.
 A leveling system has been added, providing bonus items.
 Five unique items have been introduced in the Shop: Golden Pizza Slice, Pizza Scan, Strange Pizza, YingYang Pizza (colored) and Dango Pizza.
 New UI and sound effects have been added for an enhanced experience.


⚙️Known Issues:


 The inventory does not scale properly.
 Sound volume settings are not saved between sessions.


Future Plans:


 We aim to resolve the known issues as quickly as possible.
 A Workshop will be added where users can create and potentially earn money from selling items.
 More events will be organized on Discord, offering opportunities to win unique items.
 Additional items will be added to the drop pool.
 More achievements will be added.
 Cool descriptions for all items will be created.
 An in-game store will be added.
 To ensure you get the best experience, we highly recommend uninstalling and then reinstalling the game after this update. This will help to apply all changes smoothly and prevent any potential issues.


📢 Help Us Boost Just Pizza on Steam! 📢

If you're enjoying Just Pizza, please take a moment to leave a review on Steam. Your positive reviews will help us climb the Steam rankings and reach more pizza lovers.

Here’s how you can help:


 Leave a Review: Share your thoughts and experiences on the Just Pizza Steam page.
 Rate the Game: Give us a thumbs up if you’re enjoying the game!
 Tell Your Friends: Spread the word about Just Pizza and encourage your friends to leave reviews as well.
 Your feedback is essential for us to keep improving the game and providing you with the best pizza-making experience possible. Every review counts and helps us grow!


Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We are committed to making Just Pizza the best it can be, and we couldn't do it without you. Happy gaming, happy reviewing, and see you in the pizza world!

Best regards,
The Just Pizza Dev Team 🍕🚀
